t_advice_summary_textbox.text: I have to choose the red, blue, green and orange gnomes I want to travel to the bright forest, If I wish to travel to the dark forest I am required to pick either the purple, pink or yellow gnomes to travel to the dark forest, The sizes of the gnomes and their hats do not contribute to travelling to either forest, only the color of the gnome is what matters in that regard.

vb_textbox.text: All you need to know for the game your about to play:  The red,blue,green and orange gnomes send you the light forest and the brown, yellow, purple and pink take you to the dark forest. Each forest goes through a period where it will have more mushrooms to pick than the other forest, Your job is to at first identify which gnomes take you to which forest and from where you can figure out how to correctly get the most mushrooms per turn. The size of the gnomes do not matter, the size of the gnomes hats also do not matter, only the color of the gnomes. Good luck!
